answer: A workable design: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The ledge of work and the gale of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a trellis to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
